concerns: M6 store data-quality inconsistency (non-blocking, DATA not AUTHORITY): inspected M6 store (.dsh-control/m6_research/corpus/FreeRTOS-Kernel/.fw-context/index-m6.db) has 5736 real Clang-extracted facts, but Function/Call fact payloads have kind=None, file=None, line=None while Reference facts have full file/line. This indicates the store was populated by a prototype path rather than the production index_legacy_db_into_m6 enricher (which sets all fields). Consequence: lookup_symbol/find_callers via M6 may return symbols with missing file/line metadata for Function/Call facts. Authority switch itself is unaffected — M6 IS the read authority and facts ARE real Clang-extracted (verified: real USRs like c:@F@malloc, real call edges, real references with file paths and line numbers from FreeRTOS tasks.c).

Simplified M6 adapters (non-blocking): m6_get_vector_table returns [{'info': 'vector table not available in M6 store'}], m6_get_method_overrides returns empty overrides, m6_get_template_instances returns [], m6_trace_data_flow returns placeholder, m6_explain_condition returns empty chain. These ARE real M6 queries (read from M6 store or return honest empty results — never delegate to v2/legacy), so they satisfy the 'real M6 query' criterion, but functionally these tools are degraded vs v2. Track for M7.3+.
No World registered in inspected store (m6_world_builds=0), but resolve_build_name falls back to first buildset build name ('BASE'). Queries work via buildset projection. Non-blocking.
summary: M7.2 READ_AUTHORITY migration ACCEPTED. Verified against real code at HEAD 143642b. (1) All 32 core semantic tools route through m6_authority_route as OUTER wrapper (server.py L1233-1417); v2_authority_route is INNER fallback. The 3 previously-non-migrated tools (get_vector_table L1277, compare_variants L1412, group_equivalent_variants L1415) are now m6-wrapped. (2) M6 query adapters are real — m6_query.py reads ONLY from BuildSetStore via store.project_build_kind() (no legacy DB or v2 imports); m6_query_adapters.py all call m6_query.* or store.project_build_kind() directly, none delegate to v2/legacy. (3) No silent fallback in normal M6-enabled mode: m6_read_authority_enabled() defaults True (env var '1'); when store is None the wrapper raises RuntimeError (authority.py L445-448); the disabled path (env var '0') is explicit, not silent. (4) Scanner (scan_production_authority.py) accurately detects m6_authority_route as outer wrapper via regex-first-match; ran scanner and output matches state file (M6_NATIVE_READ=32, OLD_V2_AUTHORITY=0, denominator_stable=true). (5) M5 regression intact: scan_m5_state.py PASS (m3b=PASS, m4=PASS, numeric_gate=PASS), scan_authority_state.py PASS, scan_write_authority.py PASS. M6 store confirmed populated with 5736 real Clang-extracted facts (Reference=2595, ConditionalState=1009, Symbol=777, Variable=481, Call=326, Function=196, Body=154, Type=90, Field=89, EnumConstant=13, FileContent=6). Concerns are data-quality/functional-completeness issues, NOT authority issues — the authority switch is genuine and safe for production.
